settings.title: Settings

shadowed.project: This project has its own value, so the change won't show here. Switch to "This project" to change it.
shadowed.global: Your all-projects value still applies here.
shadowed.env: An environment variable overrides this setting, so omp keeps using that value.
shadowed.runtime: A value set for this run overrides the saved one.
shadowed.overlay: A config overlay file overrides this setting.
shadowed.other: Another settings file for this project still decides this value.

settings.externalChange: Settings were changed outside the app.

login.hint: This is omp's own sign-in. Follow its steps below; it opens your browser when the provider needs it.
login.exited: omp finished. The provider list reloads with any changes.
